Monthly Surplus

Surplus Calculation:
Monthly surplus balance = Start Balance + Income − Expenses − Stallion PMS

Reduces Surplus: Recorded expenses + Stallion PMS contributions
Does NOT Reduce: NPS, PPF and PF (tracked separately; not deducted in this balance calculation)

Enter the next calendar month's opening balance to calculate and record this month's house expense. Avoid entering the same household costs again as expenses.

Stallion PMS

Add PF (Provident Fund)

Employee plus employer contributions, excluding the EPS portion, are added to PF invested and current once from next month onward, at the month start while the app is open, or on next open if it was closed. Update current value separately when interest is credited; invested stays unchanged. Missed months are caught up once.

Included in employer total. Enter your passbook amount; use 0 if not applicable.
Check automatic monthly contributions to post the employee and employer amounts from next month onward. Leave it unchecked when you do not want a recurring contribution.

Add PPF (Public Provident Fund)

If enabled, monthly contributions are added to invested and current from next month onward at month start. Update current value separately when interest is credited; missed scheduled months are caught up once on the next open.

Add Investment

Adds to invested and current value, and records each contribution.
Repeats monthly on this day (or the month’s last day when needed).

Add NPS (National Pension Scheme)

Monthly NPS is tracked separately from salary and is not deducted from the remaining balance calculation. If enabled, contributions are added to invested and current from next month onward at month start. Update current value separately when returns are credited.

No NPS added yet.

Absolute Return = (current value − invested) ÷ invested. CAGR annualizes current value against invested amount from the account start date; it does not weight monthly contribution timing. XIRR uses dated NPS contributions and current value as of today. Contributions without recorded dates are included in the opening invested amount.

Expand to review account-level XIRR and contributions. Update Balance, Edit, Delete and View History remain available.

Stallion PMS Contribution

How to use: Select a Stallion PMS portfolio from the dropdown (lists your active portfolios), enter the contribution amount and date, then add it. Contribution history tracks all additions to your Stallion portfolios.

Add gratuity estimate

Enter the family member’s current Basic salary and employer start date. The estimate is separate from investment balances.

Estimate = Basic salary × 15 ÷ 26 × counted years, subject to the ₹20 lakh cap and standard 5-year continuous-service rule. This is a planning estimate, not an employer payout quote.

Quick period
Generate a report to see matching rows
What this report includes

Both dates are included. Income, expenses, contributions, Stallion profit updates and monthly balances use their recorded dates. Current investment, PF, PPF, NPS and debt balances are not included because historical balance snapshots are not stored. Scheduled retirement contributions appear as dated monthly entries once processed. Monthly balances use the first day of the month. Annual expenses are included in full.

Data & backup

Export backup

Download all tracker records as a JSON file.

↑

Import backup

Load a validated JSON backup. This replaces current records.

A recovery snapshot is saved before an import and stays available after reopening. Keep a separate exported backup too.

Backup care

Reminders appear here when you open the tracker. Confirm that the download finishes in your browser.
Recovery snapshot

Data health

Check references, balances and possible duplicate entries. Findings do not change your data.

Clear all tracker data

You are clearing the tracker owned by , including its local and cloud records, custom values, recovery snapshot and local change log. Your login and family-access permissions remain.

Download a backup before continuing. This action requires an internet connection and all changes must be synced.

Records & statement checks

Opening saved records…

Compare with a statement

Compare today's tracker balance with a current statement. This records a check; it does not change balances. Correct an account or EMI entry in its original page, then check again.

Correct an EMI split from your statement

The payment amount stays unchanged. Enter the principal component; the balance is interest.

Archived accounts

Archived accounts are excluded from current totals and projections. Restore before editing history. Restoring resumes contributions from next month; archived months are not backfilled.

Change log

Read-only record of saved changes on this device. Up to 50 changes are previewed per save; JSON backups contain the full log. Clearing all data also clears this log. Compatibility storage does not provide a change log.

Changes save on this device and sync to your signed-in cloud tracker. Export backups regularly. Last updated: Never
